mods.name: VisorMakeMeTaller
mods.description:
VisorMakeMeTaller is an addon that allows you to change your height in the game.

To change your height go into VR Settings then Setup Addons and you should be able to adjust your height there. You can choose anywhere from 3ft-7ft or pick the Minecraft option which would set you to the proper height of the Minecraft player model.

This addon should help improve the experience by not making you feel so "small" in the world of Minecraft. This helps greatly for those who want to play while sitting down.

Note:
This unofficial build supports the unofficial Visor 0.5.0 snapshot ports for NeoForge 1.21.1.

releases.notes: Unofficial Visor 0.5.0 snapshot builds for Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric and NeoForge. These builds do not support official Visor releases.

To change your height go into VR Settings then Setup Addons and you should be able to adjust your height there. You can choose anywhere from 3ft-7ft or pick the Minecraft option which would set you to the proper height of the Minecraft player model. Camera offset and world scale adjustment options are available.

This addon should help improve the experience by not making you feel so "small" in the world of Minecraft. This helps greatly for those who want to play while sitting down.

Note:
This addon was made for Visor 0.4.0 I am unsure if it will work on earlier versions or newer ones when they release.
